component.name: OmaCalendar
component.summary: A local-first calendar for Linux desktops

description.p: OmaCalendar is a keyboard-friendly, local-first calendar application for Linux desktops. A local service owns synchronization and storage so cached calendars remain available when network providers are offline.
OmaCalendar supports local calendars, Google Calendar, generic CalDAV, and read-only iCalendar subscriptions.

A correctness fix for all-day events published with an inclusive end date: the Google and iCalendar read paths normalize the span to the exclusive next day, an iCalendar payload with a backwards all-day span no longer fails to parse as a whole, and already-cached events are repaired on read.

Notification hardening for imported calendars: stale reminders and old invitation history are imported silently, durable invitation baselines survive daemon restarts, burst invitations collapse into a digest, and inline connection feedback plus keyboard and theming polish across the desktop UI.
First stable Arch release with calendar sets, offline calendars, invitations, reminders and the optional Omarchy widget.
